description: Elections Commission - W. L. P. D. N. Udayakumara of he Kaduwela Municipal Council has vacated his office of the member of United National Party - L. M. Munasinghe of he Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the membner of United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Kaduwela Municipal Council and Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and declarations by election officials.
